procedural.notes: The ICO funnels complaints through its online portal at ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint. Postal submission is accepted at Wycliffe House in Wilmslow; the ICO acknowledges complaints within 14 calendar days and typically responds within 30 calendar days (six weeks for complex cases). UK GDPR is near-identical to EU GDPR; cookie/consent obligations live in the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR), specifically Regulation 6 (the UK analogue of ePrivacy Article 5(3)).
